newsitem.title: USA: Offshore's pilots vote to join union.
newsitem.headline: Offshore's pilots vote to join union.

text.p: Offshore Logistics Inc said Wednesday a majority of its air logistics pilots voted to become members of the Office and Professional Employees International Union.
The supplier of aviation and production management services to the oil and gas industry said negotiating salaries and benefits "could take months or years, depending on the union's posture."
"As a company, we would prefer to deal directly with our employees in areas such as salaries and benefits," said chief executive James Clement in a statement.

"With the vote to become members of a union, we are now obligated to enter into good faith negotiations with the pilots' representative for collective bargaining purposes," Clement said. "We are extremely disappointed in the outcome of this vote."
Offshore said it did not anticipate any changes in customer service.
The company's stock dropped to 18-1/2 on Wednesday, down 1-1/8.
